name: laundrybot
task: Collects dirty clothes from hampers and the floor, runs the washer and dryer, folds simple items on a built-in flip-fold board and delivers the stacks to each room.

trigger.label: Do the laundry
options: Deliver folded clothes: yes / leave in basket

bom_assumptions: Quantity-1 2026 prices. Arm: 6-DOF ~0.9 m reach, 3 kg payload, off-the-shelf actuators (~$3,800). Base: differential drive, 24 V 20 Ah battery, lidar, bumpers (~$1,500). Fold board: 2 servo-driven panels (~$400). Gripper: soft pinch gripper with tactile pads (~$550). Vision: 2 RGB-D cameras + Jetson Orin NX 16GB (~$1,300). Hamper body, pod cartridge, dock, wiring (~$850). Washer/dryer are the house's existing machines.
cost_drivers: Mobile base: drive, 20 Ah battery, lidar, bumpers
Vision + compute: 2 RGB-D cameras, Jetson Orin NX
env_changes_required: Threshold ramp at the garage -> kitchen door (garages usually sit one step down; a 15 cm rubber ramp is ~$60).
Park the car ~25 cm further forward so there's a 0.7 m lane between the car and the garage shelving (done in house.json).
Move hampers out of closets to the floor beside them (done in house.json for Bedroom 2 and the primary bedroom).
Leave washer and dryer doors able to open fully to the left; front-load machines on 30 cm pedestals so the drums are at arm height (already true here).
Laundry closet bifold doors left open, or replaced with a curtain (~$40).
tasks_excluded: Ironing / steaming: heat plus loose fabric near people is high-risk and hard to do well; items needing it go in a separate 'needs ironing' stack.
Folding shirts with buttons, fitted sheets and delicates: the fold board handles T-shirts, towels, pants and flat sheets only; the rest is laid flat.
Reading care labels: tiny, often faded print; sorting uses colour + fabric from the camera, and the user picks the load type up front.
Pulling clothes out from under beds or furniture: out of reach of the arm and camera.
Stairs (two-story homes): stair-climbing bases cost more than a second robot upstairs; this house is single-story.
Starting runs on its own: on-demand only, from the phone button.
